tool_output.instruction: On OUT CAS tab, I want to aggregate and summarize by account types. See the headers in the OUT CAS tables for the account types. Go through the 3 other sheets and aggregate each item in the appropriate bucket on OUT CAS. Order them by item number (i.e., 000011 should be before 000012). PUR Purchase should be pretty much correct if you want to use that as the example. Additionally, I want to be able to insert new sheets before the OUT CAS sheet when needed, and also have the ability to clear the existing data in the OUT CAS sheet before performing the split.
